paywall.compare.title: What each tier includes
paywall.compare.appOnly: † Text from scans and photos needs the iOS or Android app.
paywall.why.document: Free keeps one file per chat. Pro opens the whole library.
paywall.why.documents: Free indexes one document at a time. Pro keeps a whole library on this device.
paywall.why.office: You opened a spreadsheet or a web page. Pro for Work reads Excel and HTML files.
paywall.why.persona: Free includes three custom personas. Pro removes the limit.
paywall.why.model: Free runs the smaller models. Pro adds the larger, sharper ones.
paywall.why.strictDocuments: You asked for answers only from your documents. Pro turns that on.
paywall.why.voiceConversation: Hands-free voice conversation comes with Pro.
paywall.why.whisperDictation: Whisper dictation comes with Pro, for languages the system cannot do offline.
paywall.why.memory: Pro remembers facts across chats, and they stay on this device.
paywall.why.folders: Folders for your chats come with Pro.
paywall.why.exportAll: You asked to export every chat. Pro does it in one go.
paywall.why.ocr: Free reads text as it is. Pro pulls the text out of scans and photos.
paywall.why.detailedStats: Detailed speed and token stats come with Pro.
paywall.why.photos: Free sends one photo per message. Pro sends several.
paywall.why.redaction: Pro for Work replaces names and numbers before a message reaches the model.
paywall.why.clientVaults: Vaults keep a client's chats behind their own passcode. That is Pro for Work.
paywall.why.auditLog: The per-vault, hash-chained audit log comes with Pro for Work.
paywall.why.signedExport: Signed, verifiable records come with Pro for Work.
paywall.why.templates: Profession packs for legal, therapy, medical and accounting come with Pro for Work.
paywall.why.architectureStatement: The printable architecture statement comes with Pro for Work.
paywall.entry.title: Inborn Pro
paywall.entry.sub.free: See what Pro adds to the free app.
paywall.entry.sub.pro: You own Pro. Pro for Work adds the client tools.
paywall.entry.sub.work: You own Pro for Work. Everything is unlocked.
paywall.web.title: Pro and Work live in the app
paywall.web.sub: The browser version is free and stays free. Pro and Work are bought once, in the app.
paywall.web.priceNote: Prices are US list prices. Your store shows the price where you are.
paywall.web.free: Nothing here is behind a payment, and the browser version stays that way.
